alt: Amazon Prime Air MK30 delivery drone hovering low over a residential house rooftop against a blue sky
story: Amazon's Prime Air MK30 drone autonomously dropped a customer's package into her backyard swimming pool in Richmond, Texas on August 17, 2026 — then Amazon announced its biggest-ever expansion to 500 U.S. cities just two days later.
why_funny: A delivery system sold specifically on its precision couldn't distinguish 'lawn' from 'pool,' then the company celebrated with a press release about bringing this technology to 30 million more customers.
